info.title: Until Every Cage public data API
info.description: Implemented public read API. Availability depends on a promoted eligible release; documentation does not announce a public release or expose private preview data. Public access is profile-scoped and current suppression applies to all reads. Curated official is the default. Explicit community selection may return privacy-screened, factually unreviewed claims which are not project-approved; retain publication warnings and separate counts. The API does not certify completeness, current operation, factual truth or animal totals.

get.description: Paginated public facility projection for a promoted non-test release. No eligible unpinned release returns an empty list with reduced metadata. Preserve profile, release and ruleset across pages. Bbox and radius require complete inputs and cannot be combined; cursor and offset cannot be combined.

200.description: Public results, or a successful empty list when no promoted release exists.

get.description: Current suppression applies even when release_id is supplied. A missing/suppressed record returns 404; this does not prove closure or absence.

404.description: Location missing/suppressed, or no eligible unpinned release.

get.description: Exports the latest promoted eligible profile in facility UUID order, with release/profile/digest/rights and publication context on each row. Without limit, rejects more than 1,000 rows. Supplying limit=1..1000 explicitly opts into the first bounded page; response headers disclose total, returned and truncated status. Only profile and limit are effective: search, cursor, spatial filters and release_id are not applied. Use paginated JSON for larger reads. Empty eligible exports may have an empty body.

200.description: CSV attachment, at most the requested limit or 1,000 rows.

x-uec-export-total-count.description: Total currently eligible rows in the selected public release/profile.

x-uec-export-truncated.description: True when the bounded CSV contains only the first page.

get.summary: Read a compact public release map feed
get.description: Returns one map-eligible point per facility from the selected promoted non-test release. Uses the current public projection and suppression/review gates in a repeatable-read snapshot. The compact allowlist contains only facility ID, source ID, taxonomy display/category keys, precision, weight and coordinates. Exact/source-reported/approximate/city precision is preserved; unmapped facilities are counted but remain list-only. The response is bounded and fails explicitly when it exceeds the feature cap.

parameters.name: release_id
parameters.description: Promoted release ID currently displayed by the client.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Optional dictionary-compressed point tuples; omitted returns GeoJSON.

413.description: Eligible point count exceeds the documented endpoint bound.

get.description: Latest promoted non-test release for the selected profile. Canonical SHA-256 integrity checked. Only profile is effective; release_id is not applied. ETag includes current suppression generation and stored data must be revalidated.

Static implemented vocabulary and search/spatial/pagination definitions. Country inventory currently lists DK; coverage and availability are separate. This endpoint requires no database and does not certify a release exists.

Counts eligible facility projection rows after suppression, not animals or story-wide totals. Latest promoted profile; each dimension is sorted by value and capped at 20. Only documented parameters are applied: q, category_keys, spatial, release_id and pagination are ignored.

Latest promoted release-scoped public projection; no release_id pin is implemented. Check response release/ruleset before combining pages. Inferred confidence is a deterministic ruleset estimate, not a measured probability or proof of ownership, identity or supply-chain control. Preserve publication warnings.
Public facilities and eligible organizations from the latest promoted profile. No release_id pin is implemented; check release/ruleset across cursor pages.

Latest promoted release-scoped public projection; no release_id pin is implemented. Check response release/ruleset before combining pages. Inferred confidence is a deterministic ruleset estimate, not a measured probability or proof of ownership, identity or supply-chain control. Preserve publication warnings. Returns connections adjacent to the path entity. Direction/depth are not effective traversal controls and are omitted; no multi-hop behavior is promised.

get.summary: Read an eligible map vector tile
get.description: Binary MVT, source layer uec_map. Requires promoted release/profile, canonical manifest, current suppression generation and inventoried tile checksum. Exact/coarse leaves remain distinct; unmapped records remain list-only. Feature schemas v1 and v2 are supported. No names, evidence, addresses or tokens in tile properties. Stored bytes require eligibility revalidation.

200.description: Immutable eligible tile, at most 2 MiB.

404.description: No eligible map artifact or inventoried feature tile.

items.description: UUID, longitude, latitude, source index, display-category index, category-index array, precision index. Weight is always one.

total_count.description: All eligible facilities matching the filters, before cursor and page size.

manifest.description: Versioned release manifest; map_artifact, when present, describes eligible immutable tiles, attribution, bounds, zooms, checksums and cache policy.

profile.name: profile
profile.description: Select an independent publication profile. Defaults to curated official. Selecting community explicitly opts into privacy-screened claims which may be factually unreviewed and not project-approved; retain each publication_warning.

release_id.name: release_id
release_id.description: Pin a location read to the displayed eligible release/profile. A withdrawn or mismatched release returns 410.

country_code.name: country_code
country_code.description: Uppercase two-letter country code. Discover current coverage with filters/facets; a valid code does not imply data availability.

region.name: region
region.description: Exact release-backed city/region value; nonblank and at most 120 UTF-8 bytes.

category.name: category
category.description: Legacy category filter. Use category_keys on locations for the current taxonomy.

category_keys.name: category_keys
category_keys.description: Comma-separated taxonomy primary keys with OR semantics: animal_keeping_and_production, slaughter, processing_and_preparation, research_and_animal_use, other_regulated_premises, unclassified. Deduplicated; at most six distinct keys.

source_type.name: source_type
source_type.description: Evidence origin, distinct from approval or factual review.

display_precision.name: display_precision
display_precision.description: Public location precision; unmapped records remain available in results.

exportLimit.name: limit
exportLimit.description: Explicitly opt into the deterministic first page of a bounded CSV export. Without this parameter, datasets over 1,000 rows return export_too_large.

lifecycle_status.name: lifecycle_status
lifecycle_status.description: Observed source lifecycle, not a guarantee of current operation.

q.name: q
q.description: Nonblank search text, at most 120 UTF-8 bytes. Locations searches name, city, country, legacy category and source name.

limit.name: limit
limit.description: Location page size; integer values are clamped to 1 to 1,000.

offset.name: offset
offset.description: Compatibility pagination; clamped to 0 to 1,000,000. Cannot be combined with cursor.

cursor.name: cursor
cursor.description: Last returned facility UUID; continue ascending facility order in the same release/profile. Cannot be combined with offset.

min_lon.name: min_lon
min_lon.description: Finite longitude. Bbox requires all min/max fields with minimum below maximum; radius requires latitude, longitude and radius_km. Spatial forms cannot be combined.

max_lon.name: max_lon
max_lon.description: Finite longitude. Bbox requires all min/max fields with minimum below maximum; radius requires latitude, longitude and radius_km. Spatial forms cannot be combined.

longitude.name: longitude
longitude.description: Finite longitude. Bbox requires all min/max fields with minimum below maximum; radius requires latitude, longitude and radius_km. Spatial forms cannot be combined.

min_lat.name: min_lat
min_lat.description: Finite latitude. Provide a complete bbox or radius query; these forms cannot be combined.

max_lat.name: max_lat
max_lat.description: Finite latitude. Provide a complete bbox or radius query; these forms cannot be combined.

latitude.name: latitude
latitude.description: Finite latitude. Provide a complete bbox or radius query; these forms cannot be combined.

radius_km.name: radius_km
radius_km.description: Finite radius in kilometres, with latitude and longitude; cannot combine with bbox.

release_idPath.name: release_id
release_idPath.description: Tile release identifier; '.' and '..' are rejected.

xPath.name: x
xPath.description: Tile index, less than 2 raised to z.

yPath.name: y
yPath.description: Tile index, less than 2 raised to z.

entity_id.name: entity_id
entity_id.description: Limit connections to an adjacent public entity.

connection_type.name: connection_type
connection_type.description: Source-backed exact connection or ruleset inference. Neither merges identities automatically.

min_confidence.name: min_confidence
min_confidence.description: Finite ruleset estimate, not a measured probability; minimum cannot exceed maximum.

max_confidence.name: max_confidence
max_confidence.description: Finite ruleset estimate, not a measured probability; minimum cannot exceed maximum.

confidence_band.name: confidence_band
confidence_band.description: Public confidence band; historical probable/possible labels become high/medium.

include_conflicting.name: include_conflicting
include_conflicting.description: Include conflicting public connections; suppressed connections are always excluded.

source_id.name: source_id
source_id.description: Connections involving the selected source ID.

graphLimit.name: limit
graphLimit.description: Graph page size, strictly 1 to 100; default 50.

graphCursor.name: cursor
graphCursor.description: Last returned edge/entity UUID; continue descending UUID order. Check release_id and ruleset_version across pages because graph reads select the latest release and cannot be pinned.

graphQ.name: q
graphQ.description: Entity name search; trimmed, at most 120 characters. Omitted/blank selects all eligible entities.

ifNoneMatch.name: If-None-Match
ifNoneMatch.description: Previously returned ETag; an eligible unchanged representation returns 304.

Invalid.description: Invalid query or path. Application validation returns the V2 error envelope; malformed framework extraction can return plain text.

Unavailable.description: Database, pool, public projection or eligible artifact unavailable. Application errors use the V2 envelope; middleware may return an empty 503.

Limited.description: Request rate exceeded (currently 60 requests per client per 60 seconds).

Internal.description: Release/location query or transaction failure. May return a V2 JSON error or a plain-text transaction failure.

NoRelease.description: No promoted eligible release/profile; private candidates are never substituted.

Gone.description: Release withdrawn, profile mismatch, or current tile suppression generation revoked.
